general.descriptionTextModule: Manage blog articles and static pages

list.emptyStateText: Start by clicking 'Add article' in the top right.

detail.layoutDescription: Assign blocks (text, image, columns, video...) using the native Shopware editor — same as Landing Pages.
detail.layoutAssigned: CMS layout assigned. Edit blocks in the editor.
detail.fieldTypeHelp: Blog = shown at /blog. Static page = shown at /p/{slug}.
detail.fieldSlugHelp: Used in URL: /blog/{slug}. Must be unique.
detail.fieldSlugHelpPage: Used in URL: /p/{slug}. Must be unique.
detail.fieldContentHelp: HTML content — fallback if no CMS layout.
detail.fieldCategoryHelp: Custom category text. Use consistent names for filtering.
detail.fieldPublishedAtHelp: Article visible from this date. Empty = draft.
detail.fieldFeaturedHelp: Featured article appears in the large hero layout on /blog.
detail.fieldFeaturedBadgeTextHelp: Custom text for the red badge. Empty = 'Featured'.
detail.fieldCoverHelp: Shown on listing card and as hero background.
detail.fieldHeroCoverHelp: Larger image for the hero section on article detail. Falls back to cover image.

notification.saveError: Error saving. Title and Slug are required.
notification.layoutRemoveConfirm: Remove CMS layout? (CMS page will be preserved.)
